note: Cases are small .orb programs checked against the installed compiler (`orb validate --json` reports the same codes, paths, messages and suggestions for ORB_BINDING_ENTITY_FIELD_NEVER_SET, ORB_BINDING_PERSIST_ROW_ID_NEVER_SET, ORB_BINDING_EMBED_READS_ARM_WRITE and the call-site capture half of ORB_BINDING_PAYLOAD_FIELD_UNDECLARED): intrinsic and default exemptions, the [shared] group, the embed credit, persist update and delete, the render-only arm write with and without a capture spelling, runtime, shared, lifecycle and stateful exemptions, and capture resolution through a wrapper chain. The lifecycle events are fed as SEMANTICS_HEARD. Differences: findings of one trait come in first-read order; the compiler's order is hash order.

findings.message: Payload field 'payload' is not declared in event 'SAVE' payload schema
findings.suggestion: the `?` sigil already denotes the event payload — `?payload.note` lowers to `@payload.payload.note`; write `?note` or `@payload.note` instead

findings.message: trait "Child" reads @entity.note (first seen on event "INIT") but no transition runs (set @entity.note <value>); per the explicit-binding rule, every @entity.X must be set explicitly or it stays undefined
findings.suggestion: Add (set @entity.note <default-or-payload>) in the trait's INIT transition or in a transition that runs before the read on entity "Task"
